description: npm packages through pnpm, GitHub Actions and prek hooks. Weekly, with minor and patch updates grouped; versions younger than ten days are left out, as pnpm's minimumReleaseAge refuses them.

packageRules.description: Group minor and patch updates into one weekly pull request; majors stay individual.
